attributes.board_name: New Mexico Board of Examiners for Occupational Therapy (Regulation and Licensing Department)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE relevant to OT practice, pedagogy, education, ethics or theory (administration, education, communication, clinical skills); prior approval on request. Includes workshops/courses with agenda and certificate; presenting (3x presentation hours); college courses (max 20 h for 3 credits, 15 for 2, 10 for 1); book reading (up to 2 h per book); employer/approved-provider competency assessments (max 2 per period); other activities at the Board's discretion (some up to 40 h).
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates with no other license: no CE until the first renewal; the first CE year starts October 1 after initial licensure. Licensure by endorsement requires proof of CE.
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest at annual renewal; the board audits a percentage of renewal applications each year. No renewal without satisfactory evidence of CE.
rules.notes: Annual licensing year October 1 – September 30. 1 contact hour = 60 minutes = 1 CEU (as the rule defines it). A rule revision posted by RLD (dated 9/23/2025) would allow up to 15 hours carried over to the next cycle; not in the official NMAC text as read on the check date.
